info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Carrental Reservations Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: This API allows users to cancel existing car rental reservations. By invoking this operation, consumers can efficiently manage their bookings and reduce costs associated with unnecessary car rentals. The primary resources involved are the reservations, which can be canceled based on the provided identifiers. This API is particularly useful for travel agencies, fleet management companies, and individual travelers seeking flexibility in their rental plans.

delete.description: This endpoint allows the user to cancel an existing reservation, ensuring that the spot is freed up for others. Upon successful cancellation, a confirmation message will be returned.

requestBody.description: Request body for cancelling a reservation. This payload should include necessary details to identify and process the cancellation request.

204.description: The cancellation request was successful, and no content is returned.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a reservation.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for tracking the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation after the cancellation request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRespons.description: Response schema for canceling a reservation operation, returning the status and details of the operation.

createdBy.description: The user who created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Details about the audit trail related to the cancellation operation.

schema.description: The processing time in milliseconds for the request.
